Body.Content:
Sprints and backlogs in unified plans let users organize and prioritize work in a product backlog, plan time-boxed sprints, and focus on the current sprint. Sprint planning stays separate from buckets, so teams can continue using buckets to organize work.

GA date: January CY2027
